answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 1889 Country: India Title: I am working as a manager in a private logistics firm, owned by a Muslim. The trucks owned by the firm are all financed through financial institutions. Also the owner has invested in some Insurance schemes with ICICI, Gokulam Chits etc. The accounts for all these instalment payments are obviuosly handled by me. Although personally i dislike the same, as a manager i am expected to oversee all the operations. Please advice me whether the job i do is halal?. If not please advice me as how to avoid such incomes? Question: Assalamu Alaikum I am working as a manager in a private logistics firm, owned by a Muslim. The trucks owned by the firm are all financed through financial institutions. Also the owner has invested in some Insurance schemes with ICICI, Gokulam Chits etc. The accounts for all these instalment payments are obviuosly handled by me. Although personally i dislike the same, as a manager i am expected to oversee all the operations. Please advice me whether the job i do is halal?. If not please advice me as how to avoid such incomes? Jazakallah Answer ID: 1889 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1699/311=H) In order to avoid the repercussions, it is advised to keep on seeking repentance from Allah and continue looking for a legal and halal source of income, and when you succeed to find one then leave this job. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
